system.description:
"At long last!" the humble monk traveling west on his journey to collect the divine sutras sang out. Following behind, a slightly annoyed, but still playful Shinobi Son Wu. "Hey old man, how much further do we have to go?" Cried out the Ninja. "Not too much further! Only another 1000 miles!" Wu angrily followed, but loyal to the mission. Unbeknownst to him, the mission papers the monk holds are forged. The monk had gotten away with this dozens of times before, but this time, Son was the victim of this tall tale. With Sons other teammates, they faced eighty-one trials during their quest. For his service and strength, Son Wu was awarded a single apple as laid out in the rewards portion of the forged mission documents...”

- Tales of the Gallant, Chapter 2

Taoist Spirit

Tag: Setting Agnostic, Creator: StruggledKiller

The Shi Hou are a peaceful clan hailing from a small village in the Land of Earth. From birth, members of this clan are exceptionally strong, manifesting an unusual Kekkei Genkai, a monkey-like tail. The Shi Hou tend to keep to themselves, however, time and time again during Great Shinobi wars they lend their strength. They believe themselves descendants of the first Human Sage, who trained under the Primate Tribe.

Shí Hóu Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Con, +1 Str or Dex

Speed: 35 feet

Skill Proficiencies: Acrobatics, Deception.

Weapon Proficiencies: Polearm Weapon Group

Shi Hou Agility: You have a climbing speed, equal to your walking speed.

Monkey Tail: From birth, Shi Hou clansmen are born with an additional appendage, similar to that of a monkeys tail, covered in a furlike hair that matches their natural hair color. It can be used as an additional limb for holding small items with 1 Bulk, and it provides additional balance, granting clansmen 1 rank in Mastery for Acrobatics.

| #### Art Link / Pinterest Link |

Shí Hóu Features

Inner Chi

1st Level Clan Feature

The Shi Hou clansmen have their bodies permeate with a unique secondary chakra source called Inner Chi. This Inner Chi can be utilized to great effects, using more basic jutsu but at an advanced level far before others would be capable.

You begin with a number of Inner Chi equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus. You can spend this Inner Chi on any feature that calls for it. The first of which are Simple Transformations. You regain spent Inner Chi when you complete a rest of any type.

By spending 1 Inner Chi, you can tap into your ancestors playful and whimsical legacy, allowing you to partially transform into other animals to empower your martial prowess. You can send Inner Chi in this way when a Transformations trigger dictates. Select 2 Simple Transformations at character creation. You gain an additional selection Simple Transformation at 7th and 15th levels. If a transformation would call for an attack or saving throw, you use your highest jutsu attack bonus or save DC for its calculation.

Bear

When you deal [Unarmed Damage] or [Weapon Damage] to a creature, you can force the target to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, the affected creature is knocked off balance. You increase the damage you deal by +1 damage die and the next attack targeting them that isn’t from you, has advantage.

Bull

When you deal [Unarmed Damage] or [Weapon Damage] to a creature on the same turn which you moved at least 10 or more feet, prior to the damage roll, you can force them to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they are Shaken and thrown 30 feet into a direction of your choice. If they are thrown upward, you can cast a jutsu with the Finisher keyword, as if you cast a jutsu with the Combo keyword.

Squid

When you are Grappled or Restrained by a hostile creature, you can immediately attempt an Acrobatics or Deception check the hostile creatures lowest jutsu save DC. On a success, you end the Grapple or Restrain condition on yourself.

Hawk

As part of casting a Jutsu, until the beginning of your next turn, you gain a fly speed equal to your movement speed. Additionally, you ignore effects that would force you to spend additional movement to move through a space, such as difficult terrain.

If a Hostile creature would reduce your speed as a result of a jutsu they cast, you can also use this Transformation to gain additional speed equal to the speed you lost until the end of your next turn.

Bat

As a Bonus action, you can perform a Search skill action. When you do, you gain 15 feet of Blind Sight until the end of the current turn and gain a rank of Mastery to the check.

Rabbit

As a Bonus Action, you can double your Jump distance, reduce fall damage you would take to 0, if its less than 120 feet, and Jutsu you cast against creatures that are flying, gain advantage on their attacks against them.

Ruyi Jingu Bang

1st Level Clan Feature

The Shi Hou Clan can utilize tools of war as an extension of their own spirit, infusing their Inner Chi into a weapon, manipulating its form. You can choose one weapon in your possession from the Polearm weapon group, infusing your chi into it, until it becomes Spirit Bonded to you. You can have up to two Spirit Bonded weapons at a time. You can change the weapon you are Spirit Bonded to at the conclusion of a Full-Rest. A weapon you are Spirit Bonded with gains the Reach 1 weapon property if it doesn’t have the Reach property already.

While in combat, while you have a Spirit Bonded weapon, you can do the following, each of which lasts for 1 minute;

Shi Zhou Suo. As a bonus action you can alter your Spirit Bonded weapon, shrinking its size, granting it the Hidden and Light weapon property and removing the Two-Handed and Heavy properties as well as reducing its bulk to 0. Reduce its damage die size by 1 step. You cannot use Fāyù while using this ability.

Zengzhang. As a bonus action, you can alter your Spirit Bonded weapon, increasing its length. Increase its Reach property by +1. Beginning at 7th level increase Reach gained by +2. Beginning at 15th level, increase the Reach gained by +3.

Fāyù. You can spend an Action to massively increase its weight. The Weapon gains the Heavy and Critical 2 weapon properties. You cannot use Shi Zhou Suo while using this ability.

Hui. As an Object interaction, if you are using Shi Zhou Suo or Fāyù, you dispel their effects.

| #### Art Link / Frieren Manga |

Deceptive Strikes

3rd Level Clan Feature

Shi Hou clansmen are touted as experts of whimsical combat deception, striking from unpredictable angles or even completely feinting mid combo. As part of an attack made with the Attack Action, you can attempt one of the following;

Deceptive Combat. Perform the Create Diversion skill-based action. You can choose to use your attack result as the result for your check. On a success, the affected creature falls under the effects of the Create Diversion skill action and the next allied creature that targets them for an attack adds 1d4 to their attacks result. A creature can only suffer this effect once every other round.

Confusing Technique. Once per turn, force the target creature to make an Intelligence saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they gain the Confused and Concussed conditions. A creature can only suffer this effect once every other round.

Monkey See, Monkey Do

3rd Level Clan Feature

You can commit a person’s voice, behavior and mannerisms to memory. By spending 1 Inner Chi, you can cast either the Transform Genjutsu or the Advanced Transformation Ninjutsu at no action cost.

While transformed into another creature using either jutsu, when you would attempt a Lie, Impersonate or Make an Impression/Request skill-based action, you gain a rank of Mastery to the check. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 7th level, and three ranks of Mastery at 15th level.

Advanced Transformations

7th Level Clan Feature

With experience and finesse, you’ve not only gained access to new forms, but you can maintain these transformations for an extended period of time. This type of transformation is called Partial Transformation. Select 2 Partial Transformations, which you can access. By spending 2 Inner Chi and a Bonus Action, you transform part of your body into the listed animal for up to 1 minute. You can select an additional 2 Partial Transformations at 15th level.

| #### Nirvana / Battle Amp / You have found inner peace. You want for nothing, except the humiliation of your foes. When you enter Nirvana, select 3 of the listed effects. You gain the 3 chosen effects for the duration. / Recycling Chi. At the beginning of each of your turns, and once per turn when you cast a Jutsu with the Combo or Chain keyword, you regain 1 Inner Chi. / Without Effort. You gain a rank of Mastery to your AC until the end of your next turn, each time you cast a Jutsu with the Mobility (M) component. / Chi Guard. When you take damage, once per turn you can spend your reaction to spend up your remaining Inner Chi, to reduce the triggering damage by 4, for each chi spent. / Obstacle Avoidance. When you succeed a Strength or Dexterity saving throw vs a hostile effect, you suffer no damage or additional effects. / Master of Transfiguration. You can access all Simple and Partial Transformations found under the Inner Chi and Advanced Transformations clan feature. / Pure Heart. When you fail a saving throw against a Constitution, Wisdom or Charisma saving throw, you can spend 1 Inner Chi to remake the failed saving throw. If you fail again, you can spend an additional 2 Inner Chi to remake the saving throw again, increasing the Inner Chi spent by +1 for each use before the beginning of your next turn. |

While transformed in this way, you gain the listed animals benefits. By spending 1 Inner Chi on your turn, you can switch which form you benefit from. You can only benefit from one form at a time as a result of this feature.

Tiger

For the duration, the first melee attack you make each turn gains a +2 bonus to its critical threat range..

Turtle

For the duration, once per turn, when you deal damage with a jutsu you cast, you can gain temporary hit points equal to your level.

Wolf

For the duration, once per turn, if you would melee attacks as a result of a jutsu you cast, you can force the target creature to make a Constitution saving throw, vs the jutsu’s save DC. On a failure, they gain ranks of Bleed equal to the rank of the jutsu cast; D-Rank: 1, C-Rank: 2, B-Rank: 3, A-Rank: 4, S-Rank: 5.

Gorilla

Damage you deal as a result of a ranged attack, gain a +2 bonus to the result. This increases to +4 at 15th level.

Dragon

For the duration, once per turn, When casting a Jutsu with the Finisher keyword or as a Chain 3, you can gain temporary chakra equal to half your level, which lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

Snake

For the duration, once per turn, when you cast a Jutsu that affects an area, increase the size or length of the affected area by +10 feet.

Mink

For the duration, if you have an active Clone, damage it deals gains two ranks of Mastery.

Owl

For the duration, once per turn, when casting a jutsu that forces a creature to make a saving throw you can select one creature that passes their saving throw to remake their save, taking the second result.

| #### Art Link / Pinterest Link |

Golden Strands

7th Level Clan Feature

The strands of hair on a Shi Hou’s head and body carry the spirit of their powerful ancestry, allowing them to be expended for a multitude of uses.

By spending 1 Inner Chi, you can as a Bonus Action, pluck a strand of your hair, and transform it into any non-consumable item with a Bulk of 3 or less, with a quality no higher than Greater. If you create an item with charges, it has a single charge. Items summoned this way exist and persist for no longer than 1 minute.

Primal Vanity

11th Level Clan Feature

The Shi Hou clan are often seen as very self-reliant. So instead of reaching a hand out for others to let them down, they instead look inward and ask themselves to do more.

As an Action, by spending 2 Inner Chi, you can summon up to four Clones as if you cast the Shadow Clone Technique Ninjutsu at A-Rank. Clones summoned this way have a number of additional hit points and temporary hit points, equal to your level. These clones regain temporary hit points equal to your level, at the beginning of each of your turns.

Nirvana

15th Level Clan Feature

You can unleash all of your Inner Chi, wrapping it around your body like a cloak of chakra, entering a state of focus. Once per long rest, at the beginning of your turn, you can spend 4 Inner Chi. When you do, for the next minute, you enter a state of Nirvana.
